scripts.test: rm -rf mochawesome.json && rm -rf cypress/reports/*mochawesome* &&  npx cypress run --spec 'cypress/e2e/specs/*'
scripts.report: npx mochawesome-merge cypress/reports/*.json > mochawesome.json && npx marge mochawesome.json --reportDir cypress/reports/html
scripts.generateTestReport: shx mkdir -p Test_Report && shx cp -r cypress/reports/. Test_Report/
